title: A green invariant suite can be vacuous; planted mutations are what prove it checks anything
summary: The first version of the review invariant tested node['review_required'] directly, but run records store None to mean 'policy default', so the check skipped every node; both drivers stayed green on an engine that ignored review findings. Only the planted mutation revealed it. Control-plane tests need mutation evidence (supports PA-mutmut, INVESTIGATE) and each invariant should come with a planted counterexample test.
